name: 0485.KL
recent: Yes Group Management Berhad 正在完成其在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场的首次公开募股（IPO），发售价为每股 RM0.18，并计划于 2026 年 11 月 26 日上市。公司董事及大股东在 2026 年 11 月 24 日进行了涉及新股认购和献售的股权交易。公司已于 2026 年 11 月 5 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的财报。
notable: 公司进行首次公开募股，公开发行 91,867,000 股新股，并献售 45,933,000 股现有股份，发售价为每股 RM0.18。
公司计划于 2026 年 11 月 26 日在马来西亚交易所 ACE 市场上市。
董事及大股东于 2026 年 11 月 24 日进行股权交易，包括认购新股及献售股份。
risks: 董事及大股东在 IPO 过程中进行了股份认购和献售交易，涉及股权变动。

recent_en: Yes Group Management Berhad is completing its initial public offering (IPO) on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia at an issue/offer price of RM0.18 per share, with a tentative listing date of 26 November 2026. Directors and a substantial shareholder conducted share transactions involving subscriptions and an offer for sale on 24 November 2026. The company released its quarterly report for the financial period ended 30 September 2026 on 5 November 2026.
notable_en: The company conducted an initial public offering comprising a public issue of 91,867,000 new shares and an offer for sale of 45,933,000 existing shares at an issue/offer price of RM0.18 per share.
The company is scheduled to list on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 26 November 2026.
Directors and a substantial shareholder conducted share transactions on 24 November 2026, including subscriptions for new shares and an offer for sale.
risks_en: Directors and a substantial shareholder conducted share subscription and offer for sale transactions during the IPO process, involving changes in shareholdings.
